title: docs(skills): a long form stays simple, and inlineEdit names the bulk its save needs; os lint warns when it is withheld

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9MRpRmXY2bGWPCoF6DVvPuu)_

Fixes #34567
Fixes #34566

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-ui` 技能的表单类型表改为默认 `simple`(分组堆叠、一页滚动),不再把字段多的对象引向 `tabbed`,并补一段折叠分组、`columns`、`modalSize` 的选用;两份技能写明 `inlineEdit` 的保存要求父子对象都允许 `bulk`;新增编写期规则 `relationship/inline-edit-needs-bulk`(警告),登记在 `AUTHORING_RULES`,`os lint`、`os validate`(含 `objectstack dev`)、`os build` 三个命令都报。
- 为什么改:照旧技能做,复杂表单变成必填项跨页签、手机上页签被截断;主从表单能填却在保存时 405,编写期没有任何提示(HotCRM 两处实测)。
- 风险与回滚:技能只改文字;该规则是 advisory 警告,三个命令都只报不拦,不让任何构建失败,不拒收任何元数据。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts` 的 `lintInlineEditBulk` 与 `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` 里它的登记项,`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` Form Views 一节,`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 三行上限的注释算式。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/data-model-rules.test.ts -t inline-edit-needs-bulk`,应见 8 个用例全绿(含经注册表跑三个命令的一例)。
- 需要你做的:审批(skills/** 受治理面，Tier H),批准后由席位落地。

## What changes

**#34567 (form layout).** `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` § Form Views:

- `simple` is "stacked sections on one scrolling page — the default, at any field count" (the "≤ 15 fields" cap is gone); `tabbed` is "only for sections read apart", and the row names its cost: a required field on another tab is flagged only on its tab, and the tab strip overflows on a phone.
- One paragraph: a long form stays `simple` and collapses what is rarely filled — `collapse: 'collapsed'` on the object's `fieldGroups` entry, or `collapsed: true` on a form section that lists its own `fields`; `columns` (form or section) is a per-row ceiling a narrow screen lowers, unset a section draws two, so `3` for a wide data-entry form; `modalSize` (`sm` to `full`) sizes the New / Edit dialog, unset the field count picks `lg` or `xl`.
- Every statement was read off the landed contract at `origin/main` 1e4656d0: `FormViewSchema.type` default `'simple'` and `modalSize` enum (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`); `FormSectionSchema.collapsed` (refused beside `group`, so the paragraph names the object's `fieldGroups[].collapse` for grouped sections) and `columns` 1–4 as a ceiling; the renderer's undeclared section density `UNDECLARED_SECTION_COLUMNS = 2` (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/autoLayout.ts`) and the dialog's undeclared size, bounded to `lg`/`xl` (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx`). ADR-0050 rules `simple` the default layout and says nothing about when to pick `tabbed`; the tabbed costs are the card's HotCRM staging measurement.
- Eval case 19 in `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`: a 42-field `opportunity` form opened in the New dialog; `must_contain` `type: 'simple'`, `modalSize`; `must_not_contain` `type: 'tabbed'` (absent from its own `expected_output`). Either collapse route passes: `collapsed: true` on a section or `collapse: 'collapsed'` on the object's `fieldGroups`, as `expected_output` and the skill paragraph both allow.

**#34566 (`inlineEdit` needs `bulk`).** The parent's form saves an `inlineEdit` child's rows with the parent in one cross-object `/api/v1/batch` (ADR-0035), and that route gates EVERY op as `bulk` plus its write on the op's own object (`packages/rest/src/batch-routes.ts`, the per-op `apiAccessDenialFromEnable(obj.enable, op.object, 'bulk', { bulkChild: op.action })` loop). An undeclared `apiMethods` is unrestricted (`resolveEffectiveApiMethods` in `packages/spec/src/data/api-derivation.ts`), so only a declared list without `'bulk'` refuses.

- `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` Master-Detail Forms item 1 and `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` § Inline Editing: "A parent or child declaring `enable.apiMethods` must list `'bulk'`, or that save is refused `405 OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`."
- `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts` (spec-lane path, carried with this card's implementation half): `lintInlineEditBulk(objects)`, rule id `relationship/inline-edit-needs-bulk` (`RELATIONSHIP_INLINE_EDIT_NEEDS_BULK`), `warning`. It fires on a relationship field with `inlineEdit` `true` / `'grid'` / `'form'` whose parent or own object declares `enable.apiMethods` that the spec's own `isApiOperationAllowed(resolveEffectiveApiMethods(enable), 'bulk')` refuses (`[]` included), once per object, at `objects[N].enable.apiMethods`, fix line `add 'bulk' to OBJECT.enable.apiMethods`. It is a standalone function, not a branch of `lintDataModel` (which stays `os lint`-only under `DIRECT_CALL_RATCHET`).
- `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`: one `AUTHORING_RULES` entry — `tier: 'advisory'`, `input: 'parsed'`, `commands: ALL`, `surfaces: CLI_ONLY` with the existing `RUNTIME_OBJECT_ADVISORY_VOLUME` reason — so `os lint`, `os validate` (and `objectstack dev`) and `os build` all report the warning through the registry. Advisory: it never fails a build, and the registry wiring test confirms the function emits no `'error'`. `packages/lint/src/index.ts` exports the function and its id.
- `skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md`: one table row for it.
- Four CLI transcripts under `content/docs/` (`deployment/cli.mdx`, `deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`, `getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx`, `ui/react-pages.mdx`) now print `Running author-time rules (69)...`: the new registry entry raises the count `os validate` and `os build` print, and `check:docs-transcript-drift` derives it.
- Test: a new top-level `describe` in `packages/cli/test/data-model-rules.test.ts` (the existing shared harness file for the data-model rules): one case through the registry — for each of `lint`, `validate`, `build`, `authoringRulesFor(command)` lists `lintInlineEditBulk` and `runAuthoringRules(command, …)` returns exactly one `warning` at `objects[0].enable.apiMethods` with its fix line, and `lintDataModel` no longer reports the id — then the parent arm for each of `true` / `'grid'` / `'form'` (severity, path, fix, message names `OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`), the child arm, `[]` as deny-all, one finding per parent with two inline children, and silence for `bulk` listed / `apiMethods` undeclared / `inlineEdit` absent or `false`.

**Ratchet (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`).** Restatement is cut first, each cut keeping a home:

- `objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`: the derived-FK / roll-up paragraph under Master-Detail Forms (-223 bytes; the line-item paragraph's "every behaviour is derived from the DATA MODEL" and objectstack-data `rules/relationships.md` § Roll-up Summaries) and the "row-by-row" sentence under Field Conditional Rules (-97; objectstack-data SKILL.md § Conditional Field Rules, linked on the line above). Remainder raised in two pins, one per card: 3833 → 3888 → 3921 tokens (15329 → 15549 → 15684 priced bytes), zero headroom, under the standing ruling, verbatim and untranslated: 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (ruling record 6513306068).
- `objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`: the precondition (+129 bytes) is paid in the file — the `subforms` sentence folded into the objectstack-ui pointer, the related-list example's "write side" comment, "(no UI config)" — 16925 → 16916 bytes, row 4232 → 4229.
- `objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md`: the closing "target a lint-clean model" paragraph restated the table's rows one by one and is cut; 3829 → 3735 bytes, row 970 → 934.

## Acceptance notes

- **Child side included.** The cards name the parent; the batch gate judges every op on its own object, so a child declaring `apiMethods` without `bulk` is refused the same way. Both the skill sentence and the rule cover parent and child, and the rule covers `lookup` children with `inlineEdit` as well as `master_detail` ones (the relationship section teaches both).
- **Reach is all three commands.** The rule lives in `AUTHORING_RULES` with `commands: ALL`, not inside `lintDataModel` (which `DIRECT_CALL_RATCHET` keeps `os lint`-only), so `os lint`, `os validate` / `objectstack dev` and `os build` print it. It stays advisory: a warning on every command, never a failed build. `references/lint-rules.md` keeps its `os lint` framing, which remains true; widening that intro would cost tokens the file no longer has.
- **Second road not taken.** Exempting the form's own atomic save from the `bulk` gate widens what REST accepts; ADR-0035 and ADR-0103 D3/D5 carry no ruling that the form save must be ungated, so the card's first road stands.
- **Filed as #34636 (finding, awaiting triage).** `relationship/line-items-inline-edit` tests `def.inlineEdit !== true` and the association check tests `=== true`, so both miss `'grid'` and `'form'`: a `*_line` child that already declares `inlineEdit: 'grid'` or `'form'` still gets the "consider inlineEdit: true" suggestion. Not changed here.
- **L2 record 6938207311 (PASS at `2da6508c15`), dispositions.** S1 fixed in `ef4b6bc350`: eval case 19's `must_contain` no longer requires the literal `collapsed: true`, so an answer that collapses through the object's `fieldGroups` (`collapse: 'collapsed'`, which its own `expected_output` and the skill sanction) is not failed; `must_not_contain` `type: 'tabbed'` and `must_contain` `modalSize` carry the case, and `expected_output` is unchanged. N5 (literal `type: 'simple'`) left as is, matching case 1's convention. N1 (a child reached only through `subforms` or a page `details` block, without `inlineEdit`, needs `bulk` the same way) and N3 (the `RUNTIME_OBJECT_ADVISORY_VOLUME` surface reason keeps the warning off the runtime door) are follow-up candidates, not changed here. N2 (`lint-rules.md` keeps its `os lint` framing) is the accepted deviation above. N4 (keeping a required field out of a collapsed section) left as is.
- **Test placement.** The dispatch order asked for a new card-named test file; AGENTS.md (ruling record 6583487846) puts a new pin for a component with a shared harness file into that file as a top-level `describe`, so it is in `packages/cli/test/data-model-rules.test.ts`.
